crossRefs.note: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am…
Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’ ”
translations.bsb: David did not leave a man or woman alive to be brought to Gath, for he said, “Otherwise they will report us, saying, ‘This is what David did.’” And this was David’s custom the whole time he lived in Philistine territory.
translations.kjv: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.
translations.asv: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring them to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell of us, saying, So did David, and so hath been his manner all the while he hath dwelt in the country of the Philistines.
